rules: Red scores 0 but doubles the token immediately to its right
Blue scores 5 only if a Green exists anywhere to its left
Green scores 0 if it is the last token; otherwise scores 2
Doubling an inactive token always yields 0
mistakes: Red is not Green — Blue does not activate from Red to its left
Check activation before applying Red's doubling modifier
strategy: Evaluate tokens left to right, tracking Green appearances
Sum all active values after applying modifiers for final score

rules: Red contributes 0 but doubles the immediately right token.
Non-Red tokens score their base value unless modified.
mistakes: Red stacking on Red still yields 0; zero doubled is zero.
Red's modifier applies only to the single adjacent right token.
strategy: Scan left-to-right; check if a Red precedes each token.
Multiply modified token by 2; sum all token contributions.
edge_cases: Red at sequence end: contributes 0, no token to double.
Red preceding Red: first effect wasted, second still doubles next.
